title: Receipt
description: A receipt for a single compute job posted to a decentralised GPU market.

job_id.description: Job public key on the venue's chain.

market.description: Market public key the job was posted to.

host.description: Node's on-chain public key. Null until claimed.

gpu_class.description: GPU class reported by the venue. Null until known.

posted_at.description: ISO-8601 observer-side wall-clock time when the job was posted.

claimed_at.description: ISO-8601 observer-side wall-clock time when a node claimed the job.

started_at.description: ISO-8601 observer-side wall-clock time when execution started.

settled_at.description: ISO-8601 observer-side wall-clock time when the job reached a terminal state.

result_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the job output artifact (full IPFS FlowState JSON).

ipfs_cid.description: IPFS CID of the raw job result artifact. Use to re-fetch without re-querying the (possibly closed) job account.

cost_nos.description: Net NOS debit from poster wallet: escrow deposit minus refund. Units: NOS base units (6 decimals).

chain_state.description: Final on-chain job state as returned by @nosana/sdk mapJob(). Null on observer timeout.

outcome_code.description: Terminal outcome derived from chain_state and job result content.
